title: Shakespeare
overview: A man (Hamlet), a woman (Cleopatra), a young man (Romeo), a girl (Desdemona), a father (Lear) and a soldier (Macbeth) are the passenger of the 008 flight. They don’t know, but on land a conspiracy against them is being prepared. Inside the plane, an attempt of kidnapping, an electrical storm, the lose of destination and the need of one of them to jump into a vacuum; all of these take them to their limits. In the end, besides the man warnings, the characters end up with their inevitable destinies.
